full_durable_state_map.flow: persist immutable queued request -> connecting -> sent/accepted -> preparing/transferring -> durable local assembled commit -> awaiting_peer_acknowledgement -> final ack/retry -> completionConfirmed -> completed. Transport failure -> paused unless terminal or awaiting ack. Explicit cancel -> cancellation_pending persisted -> peer acknowledged cancelled -> cancelled; timeout remains pending. Peer terminal errors -> failed; already_committed only exact descriptor; status reads local journal.
full_durable_state_map.frontier: Globally contiguous zero-based partitions; per-partition chunk sequence starts1; previous partition SHA256 chain, byte counts and exact descriptor; request fingerprint/peer/session/source pin. Stage and record committed frontier before ack; no resend accounting twice.
full_durable_state_map.retention: 7-day expiry; shared64-job and128GiB aggregate quota across v1/v2;64GiB per-job,16384 partitions,100000 generated files,36600 dates,1MiB job record,64MiB durable JSON,512MiB free-space reserve. Future materialization reserves three additional input copies. Atomic journals and serialized execution/storage leases.
full_durable_state_map.recovery: Completed raw read verifies retained exact size/hash. Lost local/source spool is truthful missing/restart-required, never fabricated data or recapture under retained job. Frozen exporter engine/profile authority remains retained.

full_host_lifecycle_map.admission: Freeze request/product/profile/destination/peer/fingerprint before prepare; validate journal equality on reopen; do not reinterpret job input
full_host_lifecycle_map.partition_commit: authenticated chunk sequence/byte bounds; disk-backed incremental digest; verify complete partition digest/count then rename spool and persist journal/counters before returning partition acknowledgement
full_host_lifecycle_map.reconciliation: exact committed descriptor returns skip only when spool digest matches; lost/corrupt retained spool can cause rollback/re-request of affected suffix (v1) or replacement partition (v2); expose loss rather than fabricate retention
full_host_lifecycle_map.final_commit: validate complete corpus/manifests, materialize bounded artifact/generated destination, persist receipt and AwaitingPeerAcknowledgement before final ack
full_host_lifecycle_map.peer_completion: Completed only after peer confirms final acknowledgement; duplicate confirmed completion accepted; v2 removes input artifact spool only after durable completion
full_host_lifecycle_map.cancel: explicit marker persisted before delivery; CancellationPending until peer acknowledgement; local query/wake interruption is not remote cancellation; cancel removes private incomplete input, not previously committed destination files
full_host_lifecycle_map.expiration: seven-day record lifetime; cleanup skips active execution lease; unknown/corrupt records not silently migrated
full_host_lifecycle_map.retained_state: Current Rust stores read exact versions only; no TypeScript writer or engine-pin migration installed. Every state including awaiting ack/cancel pending and generated before/after plans needs successor/read-old/write-compatible proof. No full frozen installed-journal corpus identified; existing tests construct synthetic states inline.
full_host_lifecycle_map.downgrade: Retain immutable prior signed archives, current Rust authority and exact old job/source/profile pins. Rollback binary may resume only proven wire/state-compatible jobs; unknown outcomes pause. Do not delete/rewrite committed files or trust to force rollback. No old-to-new Node or downgrade matrix executed.

closed_interface_proposal.stage1_rule: Each child FIRST freezes its complete closed typed private input/result/error/ownership grammar, complete independently source-derived raw record/expected wire corpus and all below minima at its vector path; independent ROOT/reviewer acceptance before any source/test implementation. Below partial-field inputs are planning minima, never a complete record or implementation fixtures. Do not derive expected bytes/state from candidate output. All nested default/unknown/duplicate/version/number/time grammar follows its pinned source profile, never global strictness.
closed_interface_proposal.pure_owned_reader: Parser captures original exact-value factory reader once and checks same-factory WeakMap membership before properties, including foreign Proxy/cross-factory/closed tokens. Reader consumes bounded immutable source text/byte length admitted by trusted host, issues frozen immutable typed records with original raw bytes and profile identity retained separately. v1 signed i64 fields versus v2 unsigned u64 are canonical exact integers, not JS Number coercions. Object defaults/Option null versus absent/duplicate struct and unknown nested members source-specific. No FS, native credential, hash, provider, global state or automatic rewriting of unknown extensions. Full canonical serializer/default serde feature/chrono vs v1 time/SwiftUUID/version dependencies independently selected and source-bound before byte parity. Pure codec lifetime not Effect Scope by assumption.
closed_interface_proposal.effect_owned_bracket: For artifact read only, makeOperation captures immutable original Scope/current capability/source/destination and factory provenance once. Before any trusted source callback, register replayable original closed notification; already closed rejects before callbacks. Source.withLease owns interruptible no-resource preparation, short masked synchronous completed-allocation registration, registered suspended wait and use; partial allocation cleanup is owned by source, not caller cancellation assumption. Watcher interrupts only interruptible phases; ACK protected and watcher stop/join before terminal publication. Original Scope finalizer expires/signals without joining its own running callback; reentrant self-close must not deadlock. Protected cleanup failure takes precedence and never yields success/ACK. Pending noncooperative allocation not qualified. Busy remains until native/owned cleanup acknowledged.
closed_interface_proposal.authority_and_lazy_values: Primitive closed requests before properties; factory token membership before Proxy traps. Current source/product/profile/purpose/detail/destination/latest independent suppression and original lifetime checked before each lazy read, exact returned token identity both before and after await, then current/lifetime again before publication. Source current callback can revoke destination: job check before AND after source check. Per callback live guard expires at actual callback return before postcheck/cleanup; captured issuer/read views cannot revive or reprovide Scope/current/context. No trusted flag/callerstring is authentication. Metadata/error never echos paths/raw records/source labels/secrets. Closed bounded safe errors only.
closed_interface_proposal.commit_boundary: Pure reader/admission/reconciliation decisions perform no durable commit. Artifact read publishes only after acknowledged owned release plus final current/lifetime/exact-value checks. Future writer host separates definitely_not_committed/committed/ambiguous, local cancellation never claims rollback after possible commit, persisted receipt before peer ACK and immutable job/frontier needed. No native FS/locks/durability/hash verification from fakes.
closed_interface_proposal.privacy: Current grants cannot be inherited from old journals/backups/regrant; latest independent deletion/revocation frontier prevents restored data resurrection. Preserve health complete public authorized corpus/profile; donor GPS/device aggregate/exact sessions are distinct source/domain semantics and are not silently admitted by old health jobs. Browser URL/tab/window titles and all input telemetry excluded before observation/persistence; separately granted nonbrowser details only after authoritative app/source classification, not string heuristics.
